requirements.quote: Every record carries provenance and source_license;

serve only cleared sources or contributed copies and only data_class non-personal via exposableThroughApi (packages/core/src/sources/registry.ts:25), personal data only for the caller's own matters, per docs/legal/court-data-posture.md.
Acceptance: only cleared-source data with provenance on every record [integration].
every route added under the public API prefixes (/v1/cases, /v1/causelists, /v1/orders, /v1/notices, /v1/webhook-endpoints) must call requireScope with its scope and stay workspace-scoped.
Add a test that a key without the scope gets 403.
D-048 applies to what each route exposes (no resale of personal data); D-050 applies too (no judge ratings, rankings or predictions in any response).
every route added under the public API prefixes (/v1/cases, /v1/causelists, /v1/orders, /v1/notices, /v1/webhook-endpoints)
requirements.why: /v1/webhook-endpoints routes belong to sibling #626 (webhooks); this change adds the four data routes and a reusable per-route requireScope pattern.

deliverables.change: New core domain: gated reads getPublicCase(db, {workspaceId, cnr}), listPublicCauseLists, listPublicOrders, listPublicNotices and pure sourceLicense(source). Gate = decideSourceClearance(row)===null and, for global/shared records, exposableThroughApi(dataClass). Own-matter case data read via workspace scope. Returns provenance {sourceId, kind fetched|contributed, ref, capturedAt, confidence} plus source_license; never contributor workspace, party analytics or judge metrics. Split into read.ts if large.
Register public-api in CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES depending on sources only (import via its index.ts).
Document the public-api domain and its dependency on sources.
Register new core runtime exports: workspace-scoped reads in SERVICE_TESTS, pure sourceLicense in NOT_A_SERVICE with a reason.
Real cases: workspace B on A's cnr/own-matter data gets nothing; A unchanged.
publicV1Router(db) mounting the four routes; shared schemas.ts with Provenance and source_license response schemas.

GET /v1/cases/{cnr}: defineRoute with middleware [requireScope('cases:read')], workspace from the key (principal.apiKey.workspaceId) else requireWorkspace, call getPublicCase, 404 when not own matter or source not cleared.
GET /v1/causelists?forum&date&advocate with requireScope('causelists:read'); shared copies only from non-personal cleared sources; advocate filter only the caller's own watches.
GET /v1/orders?case with requireScope('orders:read'); own-matter orders from the workspace snapshot plus non-personal cleared contributed orders.
GET /v1/notices?forum with requireScope('notices:read'); cleared non-personal sources only.
Mount publicV1Router after the built-in routers.

Integration test: 403 per route for a key lacking its scope, 200 with it; personal/mixed/uncleared/killed sources are never served; every record has provenance and source_license; workspace B's key never sees A; no rating/ranking/prediction keys in responses.
Add the four GET /v1 routes to the ROUTES coverage map with how each is covered.

preserve.what: apiKeyEnforcement, API_KEY_ROUTE_PREFIXES and per-call billing in apps/api/src/middleware/api-key.ts
requireScope semantics in apps/api/src/lib/openapi.ts:78 (scopes limit keys only; cookie callers unaffected)
packages/core/src/sources/registry.ts exports unchanged, so the literal export lists in apps/admin/__tests__/server-actions-audit.test.ts:78 and sources-actions.test.ts:12 stay valid
findContributed (packages/core/src/network/read.ts) and listWorkspaceNotices (packages/core/src/notices/list.ts) behaviour for existing callers
assertRouteSecurity guard in apps/api (all /v1 routes via defineRoute) and the OpenAPI document tests

pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts src/public-api src/sources --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: Add a new core domain public-api (depends only on sources) instead of querying from apps/api.
decisions.justification: Core owns data access and apps import it via package exports (apps/api/src/routes/v1/billing.ts:6, me.ts:2); new domains register in CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES and core-domains.md per CLAUDE.md.

decisions.choice: Derive source_license (no schema/migration): contributed copies 'contributed-public-document', fetched records '<source.owner> public record (terms and counsel cleared)'.
decisions.justification: source has no licence column (packages/db/src/schema/source-registry.ts:54-76); avoiding a migration keeps the change in-lane. Revisit if counsel wants per-source licence text.

decisions.choice: Gate fails closed: unknown/uncleared/killed or non-'non-personal' source means the record is omitted; own-matter case data is exempt from the data-class rule only because it is the caller's workspace data.
decisions.justification: docs/legal/court-data-posture.md lawful-basis table and 'No resale of personal data'; exposableThroughApi at packages/core/src/sources/registry.ts:25; decideSourceClearance at registry.ts:~105.

decisions.choice: Do not reuse findContributed or listWorkspaceNotices unfiltered.
decisions.justification: Neither checks clearance or data class (network/read.ts:36-60, notices/list.ts:55-70).
